observation: Fresh-main inspection found the North Star Run v0.2 contract permits dwac, validation, and delivery only as object or null, while RunStore accepted arrays or scalars through create/update and persisted drift through get(). These values could therefore become runtime-trusted despite violating the checked-in contract.
changes: Enforce the existing object-or-null contract for dwac, validation, and delivery at run creation, durable read, and update boundaries.
Add focused regressions covering invalid create/read/update shapes and preserving valid object/null values.
